rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a decorative ribbon and is also used for an awareness ribbon when the cause is clear from context.

example.english: I used a ribbon to tie up the present.
example.jyutping: ngo5 jung6 si1 daai3 bong2 zyu6 fan6 lai5 mat6

rows.note: Use this for the inked ribbon inside a typewriter or certain printers.

example.english: The ribbon inside the typewriter is out of ink.
example.traditional: 打字機入面嗰條色帶冇墨喇。
example.jyutping: daa2 zi6 gei1 jap6 min6 go2 tiu4 sik1 daai3 mou5 mak6 laa3

rows.note: Use this bare noun for a plain narrow strip when it is not specifically decorative or a printer ribbon.

example.english: Is this ribbon long enough to tie up the box?
example.traditional: 呢條帶夠唔夠長綁住個箱？
example.jyutping: ni1 tiu4 daai3 gau3 m4 gau3 coeng4 bong2 zyu6 go3 soeng1
